### PTC to Announce Fourth Fiscal Quarter and Full Year 2026 Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026


October 19, 2026


BOSTON


, Oct. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[PTC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800521-1&h=1507404120&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ptc.com%2F&a=PTC) (NASDAQ: PTC) will release its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year results on Wednesday, November 4th after the stock market closes. As previously announced on October 5th, 2026, PTC entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Schneider Electric. In light of the pending transaction, PTC is suspending quarterly earnings conference calls and is no longer providing quarterly or annual guidance.


The earnings press release and accompanying financial data tables will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the company's website at[PTC Investor Relations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800521-1&h=3385078659&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.ptc.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents-calendar%2Fdefault.aspx&a=PTC+Investor+Relations) .


**About**


[PTC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800521-1&h=1507404120&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ptc.com%2F&a=PTC) (NASDAQ: PTC) is a global software company that enables manufacturers and product companies to digitally transform how they design, manufacture, and service the physical products the world relies on. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, PTC employs over 7,000 people and supports more than 30,000 customers globally. For more information, please visit[www.ptc.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800521-1&h=3560755565&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ptc.com%2F&a=www.ptc.com) .
